mapper.select:
select PROD_ID id, nvl(PROD_NAME,PROD_ABBR) text from V_REP_PROD_INFO where 1=1
and STATUS=#{dataStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and (PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
(PROD_ID like concat(concat('%',#{item}),'%') or PROD_NAME like concat(concat('%',#{item}),'%'))

select dpa.PROD_ASSET_ID prodAssetId, dpa.PROD_ID prodId, info.PROD_NAME prodName, dpa.FIX_PRE_RATIO fixPreRatio, dpa.FIX_AFTER_RATIO fixAfterRatio, dpa.EQUITY_PRE_RATIO equityPreRatio, dpa.EQUITY_AFTER_RATIO equityAfterRatio, dpa.FD_PRE_RATIO fdPreRatio, dpa.FD_AFTER_RATIO fdAfterRatio, dpa.MIX_PRE_RATIO mixPreRatio, dpa.MIX_AFTER_RATIO mixAfterRatio, dpa.EFF_DATE effDate, dpa.EFF_END_DATE effEndDate, dpa.DATA_STATUS dataStatus, dpa.UPDATE_USER updateUser, dpa.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, TO_CHAR(dpa.UPDATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') updateTimeStr from DIS_PROD_ASSET dpa left join V_REP_PROD_INFO info on dpa.PROD_ID=info.PROD_ID
info.STATUS='E'
AND dpa.PROD_ID in
#{item}
AND dpa.DATA_STATUS=#{dataStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
and dpa.EFF_DATE >= to_date(#{effdateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and dpa.EFF_DATE <= to_date(#{effdateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and dpa.EFF_END_DATE >= to_date(#{effEndDateStart}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
and dpa.EFF_END_DATE <= to_date(#{effEndDateEnd}, 'yyyy-MM-dd')
order by dpa.UPDATE_TIME desc

select dpa.PROD_ASSET_ID prodAssetId, dpa.PROD_ID prodId, info.PROD_NAME prodName, dpa.FIX_PRE_RATIO fixPreRatio, dpa.FIX_AFTER_RATIO fixAfterRatio, dpa.EQUITY_PRE_RATIO equityPreRatio, dpa.EQUITY_AFTER_RATIO equityAfterRatio, dpa.FD_PRE_RATIO fdPreRatio, dpa.FD_AFTER_RATIO fdAfterRatio, dpa.MIX_PRE_RATIO mixPreRatio, dpa.MIX_AFTER_RATIO mixAfterRatio, dpa.EFF_DATE effDate, dpa.EFF_END_DATE effEndDate, dpa.DATA_STATUS dataStatus, dpa.UPDATE_USER updateUser, dpa.UPDATE_TIME updateTime, TO_CHAR(dpa.UPDATE_TIME,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') updateTimeStr from DIS_PROD_ASSET dpa left join V_REP_PROD_INFO info on dpa.PROD_ID=info.PROD_ID
#{dto.prodAssetId}

select dpa.PROD_ASSET_ID prodAssetId, dpa.PROD_ID prodId, dpa.FIX_PRE_RATIO fixPreRatio, dpa.FIX_AFTER_RATIO fixAfterRatio, dpa.EQUITY_PRE_RATIO equityPreRatio, dpa.EQUITY_AFTER_RATIO equityAfterRatio, dpa.FD_PRE_RATIO fdPreRatio, dpa.FD_AFTER_RATIO fdAfterRatio, dpa.MIX_PRE_RATIO mixPreRatio, dpa.MIX_AFTER_RATIO mixAfterRatio, dpa.EFF_DATE effDate, dpa.EFF_END_DATE effEndDate, dpa.DATA_STATUS dataStatus from DIS_PROD_ASSET dpa where DATA_STATUS='E' and PROD_ID=#{prodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select PROD_ID, EFF_DATE, EFF_END_DATE from DIS_PROD_ASSET
(#{item.prodId},to_char(#{item.effDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),to_char(#{item.effEndDate},'yyyy-MM-dd'),'E')
